author_notes: Hardened to a product-grade L4 design_continuity Consistency (add/cross_page) task on the Codrops Filterable Product Grid store. The lever is the store's OWN native feature: a shared "Shop filter" bar (a category tab row over the product grid, All / Jackets / Shirts / Dresses / Trousers / Shoes) with a live #storefilter-readout count, rendered above the grid it controls by the shared js/site-nav.js renderer from the shared js/nav-links.js registry, so the same filter reads as one system across the Product Grid home and the Curated Edit page. On the home the tabs drive the existing Isotope grid; on the Curated Edit page they filter the shared product-card shortlist. Four orthogonal machine checks discriminate the legs: no_horizontal_overflow (the tab row must wrap on a 390px phone), visual_regression on the shop filter bar + result grid (the on-brand indigo #5C5EDC active tab and the clean product grid), cross-page dom_assertions (the shop filter bar must appear on BOTH the home and the Curated Edit page), and interaction_assertions (clicking a category re-filters the grid and re-syncs the readout to "Showing 6 of 36 · Jackets"). Reference passes all four; the baseline naive attempt lays the tab row out as a fixed-width non-wrapping strip with an illegible dark-on-dark active tab and ships the bar on the home only (fails overflow + visual_regression + the cross-page assertion, but its click wiring is correct so it passes the interaction check); the smart-wrong bad solution shingles the tab chips with a negative margin so they overlap and clip, keeps the same overflow + home-only defects, and freezes the readout and grid at init so clicking a category moves the active chip but never re-filters or re-counts (fails all four). The offline infrastructure (vendored Font Awesome + Lato, the shared nav-links registry + site-nav renderer + footer, the shop-filter markup and shared chrome CSS, and the Isotope grid hook in main.js) is identical across all three legs and is declared, not part of the task content. The Isotope grid, Flickity sliders, cart badge and local images/*.png assets are preserved untouched.
design_constraints: Keep the Codrops dark #2A2B30 ground, indigo #5C5EDC accent, uppercase Blueprint labels, and low-contrast product typography for the shared shop filter bar.
The Shop filter bar is the store's own category filter over the product grid, rendered as one shared cross-page component above the grid it controls, not a marketing hero or a separate app.
Reuse the shared masthead nav, the shared nav-links registries, and the shared site-nav renderer rather than inventing one-off per-page chrome.
The category tab row must wrap on a 390px mobile view so neither the home nor the Curated Edit page overflows horizontally on desktop, 834px tablet, or 390px mobile.
The shop filter must keep its #storefilter-readout count in sync with the active category and re-render the visible product cards so the terminal readout reflects the selection.

change_completion: The shared Shop filter bar renders on both the Product Grid home and the Curated Edit page with its six category tabs and its #storefilter-readout count.
Clicking a category tab re-filters the product grid and updates the readout to 'Showing <n> of <total> · <Category>'.
design_consistency: The shop filter bar matches the dark, indigo-accented, uppercase-label, low-contrast visual system on every page.
The bar reads as one shared cross-page component rather than an off-system per-page one-off.
regression: The original Isotope product grid, the Flickity sliders, the cart badge, and the local category assets remain intact.
A correct patch is an additive shared-component change, not a framework rewrite or an asset swap.
responsive: Home and Curated Edit have no horizontal overflow on desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile.
The category tab row wraps to stack on 390px mobile without pushing the document off the right edge.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Codrops Filterable Product Grid store; design_continuity Consistency add of the store's own shared cross-page Shop filter bar (category tabs + live count over the product grid), discriminated by four orthogonal machine checks.

problem_statement: The Codrops Filterable Product Grid Blueprint is a store demo with an Isotope-powered product grid of category-tagged product cards, Flickity image sliders, a cart badge, a shared masthead navigation rendered from a shared registry (js/nav-links.js) by a shared renderer (js/site-nav.js), and a Curated Edit page at /curated-edit.html. Add a shared 'Shop filter' bar — the store's own category filter (a tab row of All, Jackets, Shirts, Dresses, Trousers, Shoes) sitting above the product grid — with a live #storefilter-readout that counts the showing products, and render it from the shared registries so the same filter bar appears consistently ABOVE the grid on BOTH the Product Grid home and the Curated Edit page. Clicking a category tab must re-filter the visible product cards (the Isotope grid on the home; the curated shortlist on the Curated Edit page) and re-sync the readout to 'Showing <n> of <total> · <Category>' (for example 'Showing 6 of 36 · Jackets'), starting from 'Showing all <total> products'. The bar must conform to the existing dark #2A2B30, indigo #5C5EDC accented, uppercase-label design system, its category tab row must wrap on a 390px mobile view without horizontal overflow, and the active category tab must stay legible. Do not convert the store into a separate app, remove the Isotope grid or Flickity sliders, replace the local product image assets, shingle or overlap the tabs, or ship the filter bar on only one page.
required_content: Add a shared 'Shop filter' bar — the store's own category filter (tabs: All, Jackets, Shirts, Dresses, Trousers, Shoes) — above the product grid, and render it on BOTH the Product Grid home and the Curated Edit page from the shared registries in js/nav-links.js.
Add a #storefilter-readout count in the bar that starts on 'Showing all 36 products' on the home (and 'Showing all 6 products' on the Curated Edit page).

Wire the shop filter so clicking a category tab moves the active state, re-filters the visible product cards, and re-syncs the #storefilter-readout to 'Showing <n> of <total> · <Category>' (for example 'Showing 6 of 36 · Jackets').

Keep the shop filter bar on the dark, indigo-accented, uppercase-label visual system with a legible active tab, and lay its category tab row out so it wraps on a 390px mobile view without horizontal overflow.

Preserve the original Isotope product grid, the Flickity sliders, the cart badge, and the local images/*.png assets; do not add a standalone off-system rail, an illegible dark-on-dark active tab, shingled overlapping tabs, or a filter bar that appears on only one page.
The Product Grid home and the Curated Edit page must have no horizontal overflow on desktop, 834px tablet, and 390px mobile.
state_constraints: desktop_home / tablet_home / mobile_home capture the Product Grid home carrying the shared masthead nav and the shared Shop filter bar above the grid.
desktop_home_filter / mobile_home_filter scroll the Shop filter bar into view on the home so its layout, palette, and mobile wrapping are observable.
desktop_filter_jackets scrolls the Shop filter into view and clicks the 'Jackets' category; the grid must re-filter to jackets and the #storefilter-readout must read 'Showing 6 of 36 · Jackets'.
desktop_curated / tablet_curated / mobile_curated / desktop_curated_filter capture the Curated Edit page, where the shared Shop filter bar must also appear above the curated grid.
desktop_add_to_cart clicks a product's add-to-cart button to confirm the original grid and cart badge still work (regression).

Source inspection confirms the Shop filter bar and readout are rendered from the shared js/nav-links.js registries by js/site-nav.js on every page, so cross-page presence and the readout wiring are machine-detectable.
